message.content:
The angles are
\[
5^\circ,25^\circ,45^\circ,\dots,165^\circ,
\]
which form
\[
5^\circ+20^\circ k,\qquad k=0,1,\dots,8.
\]
Since \(20^\circ=\frac{180^\circ}{9}\), we use the identity
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}\tan\left(x+\frac{k\pi}{n}\right)=n\tan(nx)
\]
for odd \(n\).

Here \(n=9\) and \(x=5^\circ\). Thus
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{8}\tan(5^\circ+20^\circ k)
=9\tan(9\cdot 5^\circ)
=9\tan 45^\circ
=9\cdot 1
=9.
\]

The answer is \(\boxed{9}\).
